sourceFile: 29. BRS-201506 Report test DOE Forming sub VP- date 14.3.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable DOE evidence but changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable for final Ask AI use.
issues: Changed factor conflates VP type with multiple forming and cooling temperatures.
Unsupported temperature levels appear in the changed condition.
SPK function pairs do not preserve date, machine, and matching baseline context.
Many measurement outcomes are header-derived artifacts rather than judged comparisons.
Several cited evidence rows are not shown in the provided context for value verification.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as forming/cooling temperature DOE versus normal VP.
Split test conditions by exact temperature set and preserve date, machine, line, and stage keys.
Rebuild VP-line and SPK-line defect outcomes from actual data rows with matched normal rows.
Group NTI SPL, THD, IMP, and FO as measurement outcomes with condition headers and data rows cited.
Remove header-only/stat-artifact outcomes and unsupported temperature labels.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations prove existence only; final evidence needs condition and data-row citations sufficient for each comparison.
